zh.headline: OpenAI估值1.25万亿，AI资本趋冷
headline_alt: 开放模型网络攻击能力逼近闭源
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是“能力在加速、资本在降温”的背离：METR 证实 Anthropic 的研发自我加速接近两倍速，而 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 同时下调估值预期、开始向个人投资者募资。第二层信号来自治理端：中期选举 41 项数据中心公投中 40 项收紧，算力扩张的政治成本正在变成产品路线约束。技术侧值得记住的是 agent 基础设施的成熟：隐上下文压缩、harness 训练框架、K8s 推理控制面同一天出现，说明瓶颈正从模型能力转向工程编排。而 Claude Code 泄密与 agent 论文造假两件事提醒我们，agent 的默认权限与产出可信度，是这一轮落地最容易被低估的风险。

items.title: OpenAI 完成 110 亿美元融资，估值 1.25 万亿美元
items.desc: 这是新一轮融资的首笔款项，整轮规模可能达到 200 亿美元；OpenAI 已开始向富裕个人投资者募资，显示 AI 资本市场趋于饱和。
items.value: 估值增速放缓，融资从机构转向散户，是资本周期见顶的信号。

items.title: Anthropic 推进感恩节前 IPO，接受 1.25–1.75 万亿美元估值
items.desc: 目标募资 800–1000 亿美元，远低于此前期望的 2 万亿美元，在科技股抛售背景下仍坚持上市。
items.value: 两大前沿实验室同时下调估值预期，行业定价逻辑正在重置。

items.title: METR 报告：Anthropic 用 AI 造 AI，研发速度约为一年前两倍
items.desc: 经过 11 周调查发现，其模型改进速度几乎未见放缓，引发安全研究者对“递归自我改进”的警惕。
items.value: AI 研发自动化已从假设变为可测量事实，安全评估窗口在收窄。

items.title: Meta 推出 Spaces，与 Muse agent 协作的新形态
items.desc: 这是 Muse agent 的又一次功能扩展，主打多人围绕 agent 协同工作。
items.value: agent 产品从“单人对话”转向“共享工作空间”，交互范式在变。

items.title: 中期选举后数据中心扩张受阻：41 项公投中 40 项收紧限制
items.desc: 民主党大胜叠加地方公投，AI 数据中心选址与电力成为两党共同议题。
items.value: 算力扩张的政治成本上升，选址与能耗将成产品路线约束。

items.title: Crusoe 将陷入困境的怀俄明数据中心项目出售给 Google
items.desc: 该交易凸显超大规模 AI 数据中心开发的现实难度。
items.value: 自建数据中心风险外溢，二线玩家开始向巨头让渡资产。

items.title: 美情报备忘录：中国国安招募 Megaspeed 高管刺探黄仁勋
items.desc: 据 NYT 报道，该高管被指搜集美国 AI 芯片情报，并试图影响对华出货；同时《The Verge》调查发现获批接收 H200 的中国公司 New Matrix 办公地点为空壳。
items.value: 出口管制的执行漏洞被公开，合规审查将更严。

items.title: Google Research：普通智能手表无袖带检测高血压，检出率 65.8%
items.desc: 在 196 人研究中优于传统诊室测量，方法已上线 Google Health 应用。
items.value: 可穿戴传感与 AI 结合的健康筛查落地，非诊断场景先行。

items.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text：面向 Agent 的隐上下文压缩
items.desc: 挑战“工具输出必须以文本进入上下文”的假设，用隐表示压缩工具观测，突破离散文本的压缩上限。
items.value: 直接降低多步 agent 的上下文开销与注意力稀释。

items.title: Harness-S：从“兄弟 harness”学习可泛化的 Agent 训练
items.desc: 提出 harness 演化具有局部性、互补性与非平稳性，通过兄弟 harness 选择性救援失败样本，并把能力迁移回单一策略。
items.value: 为 agent harness 工程化提供可训练框架，而非手工调优。

items.title: SwarmEvolve：隐空间 agent 群体做进化搜索
items.desc: 每轮数百个低成本 agent 在隐空间推理、不解码文本，用于程序进化与优化。
items.value: 把 LLM 引导进化的主要成本（长 CoT 生成）压掉一大块。

items.title: TB-MathModel：首个 agentic 且可验证的数学建模 benchmark
items.desc: 让 agent 完成完整赛题式建模，并同时检验结果接近参考解与物理可行性。
items.value: 补上“LLM 裁判打报告”之外的客观评测缺口。

items.title: EvoMemState：为个人 agent 演化记忆状态
items.desc: 不再把记忆存为独立事实，而是建模新事实对旧事实的更新、约束与冲突，以及其在当前请求中的适用性与优先级。
items.value: 个人 agent 长期记忆的核心难点在“冲突消解”，这篇给了结构化方案。

items.title: Open-HumanScale：5 万小时第一视角人类视频的具身预训练开放配方
items.desc: 发布 Open-HumanScale-50K 语料，含手部运动与自然语言密集标注，并系统研究数据规模到策略泛化的转化条件。
items.value: 具身基础模型的数据配方首次完整开源。

items.title: anthropics/skills：Agent Skills 官方公开仓库
items.desc: （今日 +386 star）：Anthropic 把 agent 技能的组织方式做成公开仓库。
items.value: agent 能力封装的事实标准可能在此确立，值得尽早对齐。

items.title: hyperflow-h3-flash：31B 视频+音频扩散模型压缩至 14B、6 步、INT8
items.desc: 作者开源了压缩后的模型与推理实现。
items.value: 视频生成模型的显存与延迟门槛大幅下降，本地可跑。

items.title: Buoyant Kinference：Kubernetes + vLLM 的开源推理控制面
items.desc: Apache 2.0，提供声明式路由策略、KV-cache 感知负载均衡与按租户指标，官方基准中 TTFT 中位数降低 95%。
items.value: 自建推理集群缺的正是这一层调度，可直接替换手写路由。

items.title: llama.cpp 新 PR：MoE 未命中专家回退 CPU 并附调参脚本
items.desc: 为低显存用户显著加速 MoE offload。
items.value: 小显存跑大 MoE 的实用优化，LocalLLaMA 社区高度关注。

items.title: meta/astryx：面向 agent 的开源可定制设计系统
items.desc: （今日 +185 star）：Meta 开源的设计系统，强调“agent ready”。
items.value: agent 生成 UI 时的组件与约束层，减少产物漂移。

items.title: Claude Code“Don't Ask Again”把密码写进 1,122 个公开 GitHub 文件
items.desc: Apiiro 披露该授权选项会导致密钥被明文写入仓库，HN 上 97 分、73 条评论，开发者正讨论 coding agent 的权限默认值该怎么设。
items.value: agent 的“少打扰”设计正在制造系统性泄密面，需审计默认授权。

items.title: 开放与闭源模型的网络攻击能力差距持续缩小
items.desc: Vals AI 基准中 GPT-6 Sol Daybreak 达成 80.8% 攻击目标，开源 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 以十分之一成本达到 72.8%；同时九支 agent 在美国国家实验室开放问题上无一通过专家评审，114 篇论文未通过诚信检查（虚构实验）。社区争论焦点是：能力扩散已不可逆，防御窗口还剩多久。
items.value: 安全评测必须同时看“能力”与“造假”，agent 自主研究的可信度仍是硬伤。

en.headline: OpenAI valued at $1.25T as AI capital cools
headline_alt: METR report says Anthropic is accelerating its own R&D
Open models' cyberattack capabilities approach closed-source levels
en.observation: The clearest signal today is the divergence of "capabilities accelerating, capital cooling": METR confirms that Anthropic's R&D self-acceleration is approaching twice the rate, while OpenAI and Anthropic simultaneously cut valuation expectations and begin raising funds from individual investors. The second-layer signal comes from governance: of 41 data center ballot measures in the midterm elections, 40 tightened restrictions, and the political cost of compute expansion is becoming a constraint on product roadmaps. On the technical side, what is worth remembering is the maturation of agent infrastructure: implicit context compression, harness training frameworks, and K8s inference control planes appeared on the same day, showing that the bottleneck is shifting from model capability to engineering orchestration. And the two matters of the Claude Code leak and agent paper fabrication remind us that agents' default permissions and output credibility are the most easily underestimated risks in this round of deployment.

items.title: OpenAI closes $11 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation
items.desc: This is the first tranche of a new round that could reach $20 billion; OpenAI has begun raising from wealthy individual investors, signaling that the AI capital market is becoming saturated.
items.value: Valuation growth is slowing and funding is shifting from institutions to retail, a sign the capital cycle has peaked.

items.title: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO, accepts $1.25–1.75 trillion valuation
items.desc: It targets raising $80–100 billion, far below the previously hoped-for $2 trillion, and is pressing on with the listing despite the tech selloff.
items.value: Both frontier labs have cut valuation expectations at once, resetting how the industry is priced.

items.title: METR report: Anthropic uses AI to build AI, developing about twice as fast as a year ago
items.desc: An 11-week investigation found almost no slowdown in its model improvement rate, raising alarm among safety researchers about "recursive self-improvement."
items.value: Automated AI R&D has gone from assumption to measurable fact, narrowing the window for safety evaluation.

items.title: Meta launches Spaces, a new way to collaborate with the Muse agent
items.desc: This is another feature expansion for the Muse agent, focused on multiple people working together around an agent.
items.value: Agent products are moving from one-on-one chat to shared workspaces, changing the interaction paradigm.

items.title: Data center expansion stalls after midterms: 40 of 41 ballot measures tighten restrictions
items.desc: A Democratic landslide plus local ballot measures have made AI data center siting and power a bipartisan issue.
items.value: The political cost of scaling compute is rising, making siting and energy a constraint on product roadmaps.

items.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
items.desc: The deal highlights the real-world difficulty of developing hyperscale AI data centers.
items.value: Self-built data center risk is spilling over as second-tier players cede assets to giants.

items.title: US intelligence memo: Chinese state security recruited Megaspeed executive to spy on Jensen Huang
items.desc: According to NYT, the executive is accused of gathering US AI chip intelligence and trying to influence shipments to China; meanwhile, a The Verge investigation found that New Matrix, a Chinese company approved to receive H200s, operates out of an empty-shell office.
items.value: Enforcement gaps in export controls are now public, and compliance reviews will get stricter.

items.title: Google Research: ordinary smartwatch detects high blood pressure without a cuff, 65.8% detection rate
items.desc: In a 196-person study it outperformed conventional clinic measurements, and the method has launched in the Google Health app.
items.value: AI-plus-wearable health screening is shipping, starting with non-diagnostic use cases.

items.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
items.desc: Challenges the assumption that "tool outputs must enter context as text," using latent representations to compress tool observations and break through the compression ceiling of discrete text.
items.value: Directly cuts multi-step agent context overhead and attention dilution.

items.title: Harness-S: Learning Generalizable Agent Training from "Sibling Harnesses"
items.desc: Proposes that harness evolution exhibits locality, complementarity, and non-stationarity; selectively rescues failed samples via sibling harnesses and transfers capabilities back to a single policy.
items.value: Provides a trainable framework for agent harness engineering instead of manual tuning.

items.title: SwarmEvolve: Evolutionary Search with Latent-Space Agent Swarms
items.desc: Hundreds of low-cost agents per round reason in latent space without decoding text, used for program evolution and optimization.
items.value: Cuts a large chunk of the main cost of LLM-guided evolution (long CoT generation).

items.title: TB-MathModel: The First Agentic and Verifiable Mathematical Modeling Benchmark
items.desc: Has agents complete full contest-style modeling tasks and simultaneously checks closeness to reference solutions and physical feasibility.
items.value: Fills the objective evaluation gap beyond "LLM-judge-written reports."

items.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory States for Personal Agents
items.desc: Instead of storing memory as isolated facts, models how new facts update, constrain, and conflict with old facts, as well as their applicability and priority in the current request.
items.value: The core difficulty of personal-agent long-term memory is conflict resolution; this offers a structured solution.

items.title: Open-HumanScale: An Open Recipe for Embodied Pretraining on 50K Hours of First-Person Human Video
items.desc: Releases the Open-HumanScale-50K corpus with dense hand-motion and natural-language annotations, and systematically studies the conditions under which data scale translates into policy generalization.
items.value: The first fully open-sourced data recipe for embodied foundation models.

items.title: anthropics/skills: Official public repository for Agent Skills
items.desc: (today +386 stars): Anthropic has turned the way agent skills are organized into a public repository.
items.value: The de facto standard for packaging agent capabilities may be set here; align early.

items.title: hyperflow-h3-flash: 31B video+audio diffusion model compressed to 14B, 6 steps, INT8
items.desc: The author open-sourced the compressed model and inference implementation.
items.value: VRAM and latency barriers for video generation drop sharply; runs locally.

items.title: Buoyant Kinference: Open-source inference control plane for Kubernetes + vLLM
items.desc: Apache 2.0, offering declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing, and per-tenant metrics; official benchmarks show a 95% reduction in median TTFT.
items.value: Self-hosted inference clusters lack exactly this scheduling layer; replaces hand-written routing.

items.title: New llama.cpp PR: MoE missed experts fall back to CPU, with tuning script
items.desc: Significantly speeds up MoE offload for low-VRAM users.
items.value: A practical optimization for running large MoE on small VRAM; highly watched by LocalLLaMA.

items.title: meta/astryx: Open-source customizable design system for agents
items.desc: (today +185 stars): Meta's open-source design system, emphasizing "agent ready."
items.value: The component and constraint layer for agent-generated UI, reducing output drift.

items.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" wrote passwords into 1,122 public GitHub files
items.desc: Apiiro disclosed that this authorization option causes keys to be written into repositories in plaintext; on HN it has 97 points and 73 comments, and developers are discussing how coding agents' permission defaults should be set.
items.value: The agent's "less interruption" design is creating systemic leak surfaces; default authorization needs auditing.

items.title: The cyberattack capability gap between open and closed models keeps narrowing
items.desc: In the Vals AI benchmark, GPT-6 Sol Daybreak reached 80.8% of attack objectives, while open-source DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reached 72.8% at one-tenth the cost; meanwhile, none of nine agents passed expert review on U.S. national laboratory openness questions, and 114 papers failed integrity checks (fabricated experiments). The community debate centers on: capability diffusion is irreversible, so how much defense window remains.
items.value: Security evaluations must examine both "capability" and "fabrication"; the credibility of autonomous agent research remains a hard flaw.
